k187413665.notes: Tall vertical blade sign on a hotel facade (Washington, DC), letters stacked top to bottom under a red flower logo, seen at an angle with sun glare at its foot. A mirror-image reflection of the same sign appears in the glass building at left (distractor).

k187429829.reason: taxis (one with a readable number plate) dominate the frame; the blue wayfinding sign is too small to read reliably at 1600 px

k187429849.reason: taxi and FedEx truck branding only; bank fascia too small

k187430053.reason: moving-van branding (Victory Van Corporation), vehicle advertising

k187430133.reason: only a 'DO NOT ENTER' traffic sign; no place name (Washington Monument in background has no sign)

k187437427.notes: White letters with a 'U' logo on the dark fascia of a bank branch at a street corner; the name repeats on the side ('...ITED BANK'). The address plate '1667 K' on the pillar at left could support an addr query (1667 K St NW). Distractors: 'ONE WAY' and no-turn signs, a red 'K STREET' banner, a green K St blade at far left; pedestrians incidental.

p57aba253ef.notes: Small green street blade at dusk on a pole above a 'SPEED LIMIT 25' sign, seen through a dashcam windscreen; low contrast. Dashcam overlay 'MIC OFF/HDR BLACKVUE DR900...' at the bottom is not sign text. A truck at left is incidental.

pad819803a5.reason: dark dashcam frame; only parking-regulation plates, unreadable

c81987970.notes: Large green overhead guide sign with an I-895 shield, up-right exit arrow and yellow 'NO EXIT BEFORE TOLL' strip, on MD 295 (Baltimore-Washington Parkway) at Lansdowne, Baltimore County (camera 39.2303, -76.6499). Distractors: smaller gantry sign '295 NORTH Baltimore', roadside 'BALTIMORE COUNTY' sign, yellow 'RAMP 30 MPH' advisory, a distant I-895 sign.

c109486171.notes: Neon sign on an Art Deco facade on Ocean Drive, Miami Beach (camera 25.7776, -80.1312), night shot under red/orange light: 'BOULEVARD' in neon capitals, 'Hotel' in neon script with long swashes. The red cast and glow lower contrast; the H of Hotel is a stylised script letter.

c121641173.reason: distant waterfront skyline; the rooftop 'Ghirardelli' letters are small and low-contrast against the sky, other signs unreadable

c123862520.notes: Large cream monument sign with raised brown Art-Deco letters and a flower keystone, on a stone base at the Castleton Square mall, Indianapolis (camera 39.9122, -86.0689); slightly angled. A small building number on the wall behind is unreadable.

c133231901.reason: hand-painted 'GOING OUT OF BUSINESS' banner and 'CLEARANCE' window sign on a shop grille; no business or place name

c138077674.reason: 'SECURITY CAMERAS IN USE' warning sign next to a dome camera; no place name

c148728124.notes: Two white light-rail wayfinding blades with left arrows on a pole at Santa Clara VTA station, downtown San Jose (camera 37.3359, -121.8889), seen steeply from below: 'B' Blue Line roundel + 'Santa Teresa', 'G' Green Line roundel + 'Winchester'. Also on the pole: a VTA 'Bus Stop' flag with '82 Westgate', '17 HIGHWAY EXPRESS' (with a 17 San Jose route badge), '(408) 321-2300' and a partly cut web address. Street banners ('CREATE IN THE PLACE', 'SJDOWNTOWN.COM'), security cameras and a speaker are distractors.

c163000899.reason: abandoned roadside sign reads only 'DOMESTIC & JAPANESE AUTO & LIGHT TRUCK RECYCLING' with no business name; the lower panel is covered by a graffiti tag

c193462629.notes: Orange channel letters on a beige facade band of a bowling alley in Alpena, Michigan (camera 45.0447, -83.4549), frontal. Faded 'ghost' outlines of the old, removed letters show around the new ones (e.g. a ghost 'R' after Thunder and ghost shapes after Bowl and Lanes), which can confuse OCR. Bowling-pin logo at right. Distractors: 'FALL LEAGUES NOW FORMING SIGN-UP INSIDE' window poster; parked cars' plates are small and incidental.

c23187505.notes: Guitar-shaped neon sign, red-orange 'ERNEST TUBB' and blue 'RECORD SHOP', photographed at night/indoors against a black background. This is the original sign from the shop on Broadway, Nashville, shown in a 2006 exhibit at the Tennessee State Museum (camera 36.1646, -86.7822), so the photo is not at the shop's own location.

c30454383.notes: Ornate marquee arch sign over Fifth Avenue, Gaslamp Quarter, San Diego (camera 32.7076, -117.1601): dark 3D script letters studded with light bulbs on a striped panel. Heavy decorative script, 'Quarter' overlaps 'Gaslamp'; difficult for OCR despite being close and sharp. Partial distractors at the bottom edge: 'ART...' lettering and a round 'SAN DIEGO STA...' seal.

c85650884.notes: Cast-metal plaque with raised serif letters bolted to an iron fence, Williamsburg, Brooklyn (camera 40.7071, -73.9614); frontal and sharp. Small letters are weathered and outlined, but legible.

c94270643.notes: Retro pole sign on Roger Williams Avenue, Providence, Rhode Island (camera 41.7885, -71.4218), seen from below: 'RIVAS' stacked vertically in white on a maroon panel next to a bulb-studded arrow, 'AUTO SALES & REPAIRS' in yellow below. Ghosts of older peeled lettering show under the yellow text. Distractors at bottom left: 'NO PARKING TOW ZONE' sign and a brown 'JAMES J. CREAMER Memorial Bridge' street sign.
